package.description: Record screen and create video tutorials in minutes.

en-US.description: Record screen and create video tutorials in minutes.
en-US.longDescription: WinCam is an easy-to-use Windows screen recorder that captures an application, a selected region, or the entire screen at up to 60 frames per second. It supports hardware-accelerated encoding, live effect previews, system and microphone audio, cursor effects, and basic video trimming.
en-US.name: WinCam
